children.game_version: A balancing game using a safe, non-flammable prop to mimic the Chari.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm movements and upper body swirls while seated securely.
seniors.standing_version: Perform with a lightweight, unlit pot while holding onto a support for balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group dance, moving quietly around the floor.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and balanced to support the pot on the head.

signature_moves.description: Balancing a lit earthenware or brass pot on the head without using hands.
signature_moves.name: Chari Balancing

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Touching the flaming pot while dancing.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the powerful and eerie sound of the Bankia, supported by percussion instruments like the Nagada and Dholak.

basic_steps: Balancing the chari pot on the head
